title: Review: adversarial Opus 5.5 pass over the S48-S49 repair (ninth)
description: Read-only adversarial review of the latest commit on eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.8 (S48-S49 repair, bead .20) against 74334539, per PR review 5404301046's required fresh reviews: (1) zero-HP/link lifecycle blast radius incl. 'vanish' vs 'vanish-bonded' (derivation from all zero-hit-points records, declaration, link keep/close, effect end, re-manifestation keeping the rule only while a link is active, combat close/rebind, F3 remove/release of an absent bonded creature, S45 re-check, out-of-combat path); (2) absent x Multiple Heads x turn-boundary (head counters cleared, settlement skip, present-hydra regrowth/fire suppression unchanged). Hard rule: no SRD contradiction (bd memory srd-fidelity-hard-blocker); S1 design docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-9-s1-summoning-contract-design.md is authority. Also check migration 0039 edit and model-facing text truthfulness.
acceptance_criteria: Findings in bd notes as S50+, with authority, boundary, reachable registry scenario, sibling analysis, minimal repair, permanent evidence; overall disposition; no file changes; bead closed by the reviewer.
notes:
NINTH PASS (adversarial Opus 5.5, S48-S49 repair), bound to head 797b3b6f, diff 74334539..797b3b6f (single commit). Read-only. Probes are scratch vitest files (rv/h,i,j.probe.test.ts) outside the worktree that drive createDefaultToolRegistry().invoke, using the same harness as zeroHpVanishAndRemovePolicy.test.ts. The worktree is still clean, and zeroHpVanishAndRemovePolicy plus the combatantLifecycle suites pass (102/102).

PROMOTED FINDINGS (S50+): none.

WHAT I CHECKED (each against records.json and the S1 design, invariant 8 and matrix rows 138-139)
(1) Derivation over all 11 zero-hit-points transitions in the pack. Conjure Animals/Celestial/Minor Elementals/Woodland Beings/Elemental/Fey (effect->ended plus presence->absent) give 'vanish'. Simulacrum (integrity->destroyed) gives 'vanish'. Find Familiar and Find Steed (presence->absent only) give 'vanish-bonded'. Animate Objects and Giant Insect (form->original) give 'revert'. No record declares conflicting transitions, so the new ambiguity throw cannot fire. Find Familiar and Find Steed spell sources are refused as instantaneous for every duration (probe H6), so the doc claim is true and the bonded derivation is a correct but currently unreachable branch.
(2) Declaration. The enum is ['vanish','vanish-bonded']. Declaring 'vanish-bonded' on spell:conjure-animals is refused with a precise message (J4).
(3) Bonded 0 HP through the registry (H1/I1/J2). The creature becomes absent and its link and the effect stay active. The result reports {rule:'vanish-bonded', effectId, effectEnded:false, linkKept:true}, and the message is truthful. Concentration it holds breaks with owner-removed (J2: it owned a Conjure Animals, whose beast is removed and whose effect ends). SRD: "When the familiar drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form" (Find Steed text is equivalent). S1 matrix: 0 HP -> absent/active. This matches.
(4) Combat close with an absent bonded creature (H2/H3). The link is rebound to the campaign actor, and the actor is absent with zeroHpRule 'vanish-bonded'. Re-admission with HP above 0 returns it alive and keeps the rule. A second 0 HP in c2 reports linkKept against 'fam' through the actorId matcher (I2), and a second close and re-admission in c3 still keeps the rule. Re-admission at 0 HP, in any status, is refused for both an absent and an alive bonded actor (H3/H4), so S47 holds for the new rule.
(5) Effect end, i.e. F3 remove/release of an absent bonded creature (I1). end_effect 'ruled' with cleanupOnEnd 'remove' marks the link removed (the remove seam returns 'removed' for a creature already absent); with 'release' it marks the link released. Either way the creature stays absent and the effect ends. A later re-admission drops the rule (rule kept only while a link is active). 'dismissed' is refused for these non-dismissible ruling effects, so permanent dismissal from 0-HP absence needs an explicit noted ruling. That is consistent with ambiguity:find-familiar-permanent-dismissal-after-zero-hp (canonicalResolution null, owner campaign-ruling).
(6) S45 re-check. requireParticipant still refuses an absent bonded creature before the replacement end. A prior effect's links all close with it, so no absent creature keeps an active link to an ended effect.
(7) S49 (S49 regression test plus I4/I5). toAbsent clears the four turn-bound head fields, and persistCombatantLifecycle writes them. The pure invariant now requires them to be zero for absent. settleCombatantHeadsAtTurnEnd skips absent at both actionEconomy call sites (begin_turn :817 and :981). Cases tested: an own-turn head loss followed by lethal 'vanish' damage, and a head loss on another creature's turn followed by a 'vanish-bonded' drop. In both, the next begin_turn succeeds and the absent hydra gets no regrowth. Re-admission is a fresh 5-headed manifestation that keeps vanish-bonded only while its link is active. Present-hydra regrowth and fire suppression are untouched; only the early return changed.
(8) Migration 0039. It is not on origin/main (main ends at 0031), so editing it in-branch is legitimate. The schema snapshot and the CHECK constraint agree, and readCombatLifecycle validation accepts the new value.
(9) Model-facing text in start_effect, update_combatant and start_encounter matches the code paths I probed, apart from O-1 below.

NON-PROMOTED OBSERVATIONS (not material; recorded for the captain)
O-1 (truthfulness nit) encounterCombatants.ts:2622-2638. The zeroHpRule property survives a release, which is intended and documented. So a PRESENT 'vanish-bonded' creature whose link was explicitly released (H5: cleanupOnEnd 'release' plus a ruled end), and which later drops to 0 HP, reports linkKept:true with effectId:null. The message is still truthful (it ends with '.', no bond claimed). Reaching this needs a release that S1 itself makes terminal (absent/none), and state stays consistent because re-admission drops the rule. Optional repair: linkKept = bonded && closed.effectId !== null.
O-2 (doc nit) docs/active-effect-lifecycle.md:385-388 (section 8) still says the 0-HP rule never carries over on re-admission. Section 9 (:409-414) and the start_encounter tool text state the bonded exception correctly. This is internal doc drift, not model-facing.
O-3 (evidence suggestion) The S48 test covers 0 HP, link kept, re-admission and rule kept. It does not cover a terminal end of an absent bonded familiar (the I1 path: ruled end, then the rule is dropped on re-admission), which review 5404301046 asked to protect "if represented". I probed that path and it works. Adding one row would be proportionate, but its absence is not a defect.
O-4 (pre-existing class, not introduced here) An instance-only bonded creature (no campaignActorId, template combatant) loses its link at combat close (released, combat-ended). This happens whether it is present or absent, and the tool text directs campaignActorId for persistent owned creatures. Exhaustion level 6 kills a bonded familiar outright while its link stays active, same as 'vanish' before this commit; the SRD 0-HP clause does not cover death without 0 HP.

DISPOSITION: APPROVE. The S48 and S49 repairs hold under adversarial registry probing, and I found no SRD contradiction and no material reachable defect in the zero-HP/link or absent x Multiple Heads blast radius.
